payload.reason: The evidence specifies the hyperparameters related to the number of clusters and types of word vectors used in the experiments.

claims.text: The hyperparameters varied in the experiments include the number of clusters (between 250 and 1000) and the type of word vectors (skip-gram, cbow, GloVe).

The experiments systematically evaluated the effect of cluster membership features on four tasks: named entity segmentation, named entity classification, fine-grained sentiment classification, and fine-grained sentiment quantification.
